summary: Backend regression suite passed all 3 tests. Live UI auth, Google placeholder, founder login, and shell load passed; discussion-room cards failed to render after navigation despite a successful API response.

integration_issues.issue: Discussion rooms heading renders but [data-testid=discussion-room] cards remain absent. GET /api/rooms returns 200 with 3 records in API and backend logs.

action_items: Investigate Shell refresh/state timing and ensure rooms response populates room-grid reliably; add visible loading/error state for failed Promise.all requests.
critical_code_review_comments: Shell uses one unhandled Promise.all for feed, rooms, and teacher updates; one failed request can silently leave all sections empty. Add per-request error handling/loading state.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed student and post through public APIs; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth cookie/me/logout, registration, feed persistence, public rooms/teacher endpoints, invalid login, Google placeholder, and founder info were exercised. Recheck room cards and then continue teacher/info/post/image/mobile flows.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login as admin@nsec.edu, click Discussion rooms, observe heading with blank content. API GET /api/rooms is 200 and returns records; App.js refresh stores rooms through Promise.all without catch or loading/error state, indicating a client-side timing/state update problem or swallowed request failure.
